description: Send a PDF for electronic signature and get the signing links back. One call: the PDF (an attachment already on an item, see list_uploaded_files / request_file_upload, or the bytes as base64), the signers, and optionally the row it belongs to. Each signer opens a personal link with an expiry, confirms a one-time code sent to their email or WhatsApp, reads the document and signs; the platform then seals the PDF with an evidence page and emails every signer the signed copy. With no fields, a signature page (name, signature, date per signer) is added at the end, so "read, then sign at the end" needs no coordinates. With itemId and signedFileColumnId (a file column on that item's board), the signed PDF is added to that cell when everyone has signed: build what happens next as an automation on "column value changed" of that column (set a status, notify, webhook). sendEmail=false skips the invitation emails and the links are yours to hand over (WhatsApp, open on the agent's phone). For a customer app the same thing is in its own API: /api/_esign (script /api/_esign/sign, TaskLiteSign).

expiryDays.description: How long the links work. Default 14

fields.description: Where each signer signs. Omit to append a signature page

x.description: Fraction of page width from the left

y.description: Fraction of page height from the top

itemId.description: The row this document belongs to

message.description: A note shown in the invitation and on the signing page

organizationId.description: Organization id; defaults to the credential organization when omitted

pdfAttachmentId.description: Attachment id of a PDF already uploaded (list_uploaded_files)

pdfBase64.description: Or the PDF itself, base64 (up to 10MB)

sendEmail.description: Email invitations. Default true; links are returned either way

sendSignedCopy.description: Email every signer the signed copy at the end. Default true

signedFileColumnId.description: File column on the item's board that receives the signed PDF

email.description: Required: the code (unless WhatsApp) and the signed copy go here

order.description: Signing order; equal orders sign in parallel, later orders are invited when earlier ones finish

name: create_signature_request
